label: PF Backlog 598
title: EDP-17: Canonical PostgreSQL schema (tenants/memberships/projects/runs/stages/attempts/artifacts/usage/quotas/audit/schema_migrations) + indexes + pooling + optimistic versioning

brief.problem: No canonical relational schema; state is scattered in registries and files.
brief.what_adds: Versioned PostgreSQL schema with pooling and optimistic versioning.
brief.why: Blocks artifacts metadata, audit store, quotas, and enterprise multi-tenancy.
brief.who_feels: Every downstream EDP phase and enterprise customers.

objective: Deliver the canonical PostgreSQL schema (tenants, memberships, projects, runs, stages, attempts, artifacts, usage, quotas, audit, schema_migrations) with indexes, connection pooling, and optimistic versioning.
acceptance_criteria: All listed tables created via versioned migrations with indexes for hot query paths
No auto-migrate on startup; migrations run via BI-PF-1300 tooling with separated DB roles
Go data layer uses pooled connections and enforces optimistic version conflicts
EXPLAIN-verified indexes for tenant/run/stage listing queries
in_scope: Pool config + optimistic versioning in Go DAL
Deferral (BI-PF-1309): resolve backlog bookkeeping-commit churn by moving the canonical backlog SoR to Postgres here (JSON files become derived/server state; per-write bookkeeping commits end).
out_of_scope: Row-level business logic (services in later items)
approach: Draft DDL per domain object, review with EDP-20 audit shape, implement migrations, add DAL with version columns, validate queries with EXPLAIN(ANALYZE,BUFFERS).
risks: Premature table shapes if EDP-20/EDP-22 designs shift audit/usage semantics
Pooling/optimistic-locking conventions not yet agreed across Go services
rollback: Down-migrations per version; no startup auto-migrate so app can pin prior schema version.
summary: PARTIAL delivery (EDP-17, P0): (1) schema slice 1 migrations/0002_core_schema (tenants/memberships/projects/runs/stages/attempts/usage/quotas); (2) model docs/EDP-17-SCHEMA.md; (3) ports+adapters map docs/EDP-STORAGE-ADAPTERS.md; (4) DB bootstrap scripts/dev/db_bootstrap.py + docker-compose.edp.yml + PF_DB_DSN; (5) Go DAL ports+Postgres adapter go/store (PR #178). REMAINING: domain slices 2+ (identity/agents/events/jobs/packaging/artifacts deferred per doc), wiring the EDP-08 migration runner. Status stays open until slices complete.

analysis.implementation_strategy: Define canonical PostgreSQL schema as versioned migrations under the BI-PF-1300 migration framework; add Go data-access layer with pool configuration and optimistic versioning (version columns) matching existing /api/v1/enterprise and run/stage APIs.
conflict_findings: BI-PF-1312 also splits orchestrator/storage and touches audit tables — align table ownership early
duplication_findings: core/schema_validator.py validates but does not define a relational schema — complementary, not duplicated
Existing config/store-registry.json covers object stores, not relational tables
analysis.rationale: Foundational schema blocking artifacts metadata and audit work; must land via the migration framework, not ad hoc.
assumptions: PostgreSQL is the sole RDBMS; BI-PF-1300 migration framework API is settled
Tenants/runs/stages domain model from /api/v1/enterprise and /api/v1/engineering maps 1:1 to tables
risks: Premature table shapes if EDP-20/EDP-22 designs shift audit/usage semantics
Pooling/optimistic-locking conventions not yet agreed across Go services
missing_info: Optimistic versioning convention (integer version vs updated_at etag)
Audit table partitioning/retention needs at design time

context_review.reason: Domain entities are visible in existing APIs; two conventions need a human decision.
